title: Dezz05/AuraSDK
description: Enable fast, local memory recall for AI agents using a lightweight, Rust-based cognitive memory engine with no cloud or LLM calls needed.

title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: 7yuling/ATEE
description: ATEE is a lightweight AI security agent plugin deployed on the website administrator's server or a security node within the same intranet. title: wuyoscar/Internal-Safety-Collapse
description: Internal Safety Collapse (ISC): Turning the LLM or an AI Agent into a sensitive data generator.

title: Light-Heart-Labs/DreamServer
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

title: bgill55/daedalus
description: Daedalus is a standalone terminal-based AI coding assistant that runs on your machine. It connects to local LLM servers (LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) or remote providers (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Anthropic), routes requests intelligently, and gives your AI agent access to your file system, terminal, git, web search, and codebase indexing

title: SametAtas/rein
description: Deterministic, no-LLM guardrails for AI-written code: reproducible PASS/WARN/BLOCK verdicts an agent, a person, or CI can call.

title: dariank38/agentic-job-scraper
description: # Agentic Job Scraper - an AI-powered job monitoring system that scrapes Telegram channels, RSS feeds (V2EX, 电鸭社区), and job boards (Bossjob.com), analyzes postings with Ollama or NVIDIA LLMs, and helps developers track job opportunities with built-in AI resume generation, enhancement and scoring.

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: stephonGAO/milu
description: Production-ready multi-user AI agent framework — 9 LLM providers with Chinese models (Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM) first-class. Built-in tools, MCP, RAG, sub-agents, skills, scheduler and an agent pool. Run it as a CLI/service, or embed it as a library.

title: tjpoisal/UNIMATRIX
description: Unimatrix is a cloud-native AI memory system that gives any LLM instant, persistent context across devices and sessions. Built around the Model Context Protocol (MCP), it eliminates the need to re-explain context every time you switch tools or devices. Dual-layer mem, hybrid retrieval w/ recency decay, a Librarian agent, and enterprise encryption.

title: shaumik/PokeArena
description: A Pokémon battle arena where any agent can play — human, deterministic game-tree AI, or LLM — over an open WebSocket protocol (MCP, CLI, or your own client). One leaderboard, ranked by who plays best.

title: XAIHT/Tlamatini
description: Tlamatini is a self-hosted AI developer assistant for local or cloud LLMs: hybrid RAG over your codebase, a 79-tool multi-turn engine, a 74-agent visual workflow designer, and ACPX, a runtime for external coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini CLI.

title: eugenelim/llm-wiki-kit
description: Configurable group operating system and LLM Wiki knowledge management kit for teams and families. Obsidian vault templates, agent skills, and scripts for building structured, AI-maintained markdown knowledge bases. Works with Claude Code, Cowork, or any LLM agent. Includes work and family variants.

title: lucasmailland/mnemosyne
description: Cognitive memory for AI agents. Bitemporal, multi-tenant Postgres + pgvector. Hybrid recall (BM25 + vectors + graph) with BYO LLM. Use as a library, HTTP API, or MCP server.

title: ananymishra1/SHIMS
description: SHIMS Omni + Council of the Wise — Self-hosted, multi-agent AI    │ assistant with local-first LLM support, cloud provider routing, voice    │ chat, code interpreter, and the DuoBot Council mode. Runs on    │ Windows/Linux with Ollama or cloud APIs.

title: icosaedro-git/toolsnap-mcp
description: One MCP connector to expand any AI agent or local LLM — no accounts, just a USDC wallet (no gas). 23 free tools + fetch_extract (98.1% fewer tokens). x402 on Base · $0.02/call or $0.01 prepaid.

title: khoj-ai/khoj
description: Your AI second brain. Self-hostable. Get answers from the web or your docs. Build custom agents, schedule automations, do deep research. Turn any online or local LLM into your personal, autonomous AI (gpt, claude, gemini, llama, qwen, mistral). Get started - free.

title: DLhugly/Clif-Code
description: AI code editor + terminal coding agent, built in Rust. Works with any LLM via OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, or Ollama. 20MB native binary, 20 themes, real terminal, git, agent sidebar with tool calling.

title: ianasasira/tokenreducer
description: A "token reducer" is a preprocessing tool or SaaS that condenses large, data-heavy files into streamlined formats (like optimized Markdown, AST summaries, or stripped text). This allows developers and AI agents to feed information into LLMs without hitting context limits or racking up massive API bills.
